text:
carla: T-minus 45 to change window start for EU slice (22:00 UTC). Quick run-through: pins, canary warm, smoke, rollback criteria, release notes published? Reply with ✅ when you’ve verified your area.

deploy-bot: Canary pool: warm (3/3), pinned to model v3.1-canary for eu-west. Beginning gradual drain at 22:10 if no errors. /deploy status --canary

alice: ✅ smoke tests green on staging and shadow traffic looks OK. Latency distribution stable at p50/ p95: 27ms / 210ms. Will keep watch.

ben: Release notes pushed to docs site and sent to #marketing. One callout: embeddings service has a small cost spike in stress test — we throttled batch size. Not blocking but FYI.

carla: @ben thanks. For embeddings throttle, set batch_size cap to 8 for the first hour of rollout. Add to runbook under "soft limits".

dave: Can we hold off on auto-traffic-shift for the sidebar-search lambda? Last deploy had a minor 5xx blip. If approved I'll pin it to previous for 30m.

carla: Yes hold. Marking sidebar-search as manual shift. Dave please run the pin command:
```
/deploy pin service=sidebar-search version=20260314-rc3 reason="holdpoint after blip"
```

dave: Done. Confirmed pin.

oncall: Oncall will standby 22:00-23:00. Escalation path: pager -> oncall-sre -> eng-release-owner. Playbook link: https://company.internal/runbooks/launch-holdpoint.md

carla: Rollback criteria we agreed: any of the following within first 30m -> immediate rollback:
- error rate increase > 2pp (absolute) or sustained > 3%
- p95 latency increase > 250ms vs baseline
- customer-facing 5xx spike > 1/min for 5min
If threshold hit, call rollback and add `--reason=auto-slo` to /deploy rollback.

deploy-bot: Noted. Autotrigger disabled for sidebar-search (manual). Autotrigger enabled for core-api with thresholds set: errors=2.0, p95_delta=250ms.

alice: Small ask — can we enable extra metric retention for tokens-per-request on the first hour? I want minute granularity for anomaly hunting.

carla: Go for it. @eng-infra please bump retention and forward minute bins to the release channel.

ben: One more: if we need a hotfix after rollback, I want to avoid reintroducing the embedding batch-size change without a canary. Keep patch pinned until next canary passes.

carla: Agreed. Add to post-rollback checklist: 1) Block re-merge of embedding change 2) Run targetted regressions 3) Notify customers on status page if >30m impact.

oncall: Quick note — I'll capture logs and upload a summary gist if we hit anything odd. Slack reactions only for status, no noisy alerts to channel unless critical.

carla: Final check: everyone who replied with ✅, please set your Slack status to "launch-watch" and stay available for 45m. If no objections, we'll flip the traffic holdpoint at T-0 and start gradual 10%/5min ramp after 5m.

dave: ✅ status set.

alice: ✅

ben: ✅

carla: Ok launching the window. I'll post a short note in #general after 30m if all stable. Good luck team :rocket:

deploy-bot: Traffic holdpoint released at 22:00:00 UTC. Canary ramp schedule active: 10% -> 20% -> 40% -> 100% unless stopped. Logs routed to #eng-releases and /var/logs/releases/1719876543-canary.log
